## Download

- `WoW Forever Buddy_<version>_x64-setup.exe`: installer (recommended)
- `WoW Forever Buddy_<version>_x64_en-US.msi`: MSI installer
- the plain `.exe`: portable, runs without installing
- `ForeverBuddy-<addon version>.zip`: the companion addon, if you install it by hand

The builds are unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen warns the first time: **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
